Header: Magnaporthe grisea Sinhala – Kolapaluwa, Tamil –Kurakkan Eripantham

Prevention: Deep plough the field to bury infected residues
Use recommended seed rate (sowing 8 kg/ha; row seeding 4-5 kg/ ha, transplanting 3 kg/ha)
Monitoring: Look for small, brown, circular, elongated spots developing into a large elongated spindle-shaped area
Observe for black and shrink neck region
Look for symptoms on alternative hosts such as grasses
Direct Control: Rate of dilution – 7g/10 lit. of water
Rate of dilution – 6 ml/10 lit. of water
Rate of dilution – 6g/10 lit. of water
Restrictions: Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticides.
Read the manufacturer’s instructions carefully before handling pesticides.#
Do not eat, smoke or drink while spraying pesticides.
Do not repeat application of pesticides with the same mode of action.
U – Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use.
